name: fountain
description: A library and command line program for working with Fountain script/screenplay formatted files.
releaseNotes: Maintenance release; the parser and the three programs are unchanged from 1.0.3. Go 1.27.3 is the minimum version. The build and release tooling follows the workspace standard: check-go-version and check-committed in the Makefile, a release built from a clean, pushed commit, release.bash with --dry-run, release.ps1 with checksums, no armv7l target, no pagefind search on the website.
